## Motivation

Previous PRs plan one window sub-pool per window length and refuse, at binding, a runner whose layers span more window sub-pools than its backend serves (every backend serves one). This PR lets the Triton backend serve any number of window sub-pools, each through its own rail, and carries write locations by sub-pool name.

## Modifications

- Triton (`layers/attention/triton_backend.py`): one rail per window sub-pool in eager extend, eager decode and decode CUDA graphs (window length, read indptr and indices, graph buffers, write ids). With one window sub-pool nothing changes (no extra rail, same buffers, kernels and graph shapes). Triton serves several window sub-pools without speculative decoding, decode context parallelism, deterministic windows, dLLM, MLA or a shared indptr buffer; otherwise one.
- Write locations: `KVWriteLoc.window_locs` carries every window's write ids keyed by sub-pool name; `swa_loc` is removed and the fields after `loc` are keyword-only. All attention backends (CUDA, AMD aiter, Intel AMX, torch native, XPU, MUSA, NPU) and the CP strategies take `window_locs`; DFlash and DSpark draft writers key them by layer route (`mem_cache/kv/router.py`, `routed_cache.py`, `memory_pool.py`, `swa_memory_pool.py`).
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_triton_several_windows.py`, `test_window_write_locations.py` with a recorded golden of the rows every attention layer writes and reads (`window_write_locations_golden.json`, regenerate with `SGLANG_REGEN_WINDOW_WRITE_GOLDEN=1`), `test/registered/unit/models/test_draft_sliding_window_rules.py`, plus updates to backend, draft placement and NPU tests.

**API change for backend implementers:** `KVWriteLoc.swa_loc` is gone; read a window's write ids from `window_locs[sub_pool]`. No serving behavior change for current models: the production configurator declares one target window.

## Accuracy Tests

Serving validation was run at the **top of this 26-PR stack** (the cumulative change), not at this PR's head. Software: torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GSM8K is few-shot, 500 or 1319 questions as noted; `main` is the same commit the stack is based on, same flags.

| Hardware | Model | Configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, `--enable-unified-memory` (rebased stack) | 0.954 (1319 q) | 0.950–0.954 |
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP1, `--enable-unified-memory --max-total-tokens 120000` (rebased stack) | 0.842 (1319 q) | 0.839 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, MTP (EAGLE, 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens) | 0.951, accept length 3.56 | 0.953, 3.56 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, DFlash draft | 0.951, accept length 5.42 | 0.952, 5.44 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PD (prefill TP1 + decode TP1, mooncake), unified, repeated runs | 0.952–0.960, no hang | 0.954–0.958 |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | PD (TP1 + TP1, mooncake), unified | 0.810 | 0.808 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, HiCache | 0.954 | — |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PP2, unified | 0.953 | 0.955 (static pools) |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified (500 q) | 0.958 | 0.960 |
| 2x B200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified, `trtllm_mha` (1319 q) | 0.849 | 0.863 |
| 2x B300 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B / openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified | 0.950 / 0.849 | 0.954 / 0.849 |

On B200 and B300, 40 greedy GSM8K generations were compared with `main`: 35–40 of 40 are identical, and the rest first differ after at least 27 characters (near ties). The H200 runs above other than the two marked "rebased stack" were run at the stack top before it was rebased onto the current base; the code they cover is unchanged by the rebase except for conflict resolutions.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured at the stack top, same flags as `main` (bench_serving, random 4096-in / 512-out unless noted):

| Hardware | Model / configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b, unified, `--max-total-tokens 120000` | 3.93–3.95 req/s | 3.95 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B PD (TP1 + TP1), 2048-in / 256-out | 5.65–6.28 req/s | 6.21–6.29 req/s |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b PD (TP1 + TP1) | 9.39–9.45 req/s | 9.21 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B MTP TP2 / DFlash TP2 | 4.26 / 4.36 req/s | 4.29 / 4.35 req/s |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B TP2 / openai/gpt-oss-120b TP2 | 6.35 / 19.31 req/s | 6.34 / 19.28 req/s |

+"""Triton attention over a unified pool whose layers attend through several

+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.plan import plan_kv_storage
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.sizing import KVSizingInputs, size_plan
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_mode import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel

+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.attention_unittest.attention_methods import (
+    dense_attention as _kit,
+)
+from sglang.test.kits.attention_unittest.attention_methods.dense_attention import (
+    DenseAttentionCase,
+    MockModelRunner,
+    TinyModelConfig,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+from sglang.test.unified_allocator_fixtures import setup_allocator_context

+# keep it to this module's tests so later tests in the process see none.
+_kit._parallel_override.__exit__(None, None, None)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+_HEADS, _KV_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM = 4, 2, 64
+_DTYPE = torch.float16
+_CONTEXT = 64
+_ATOL = _RTOL = 3e-2
+
+
+def _storage(windows):
+    geometry = MHAGeometry(
+        head_num=_KV_HEADS,
+        head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+        v_head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+        kv_cache_dtype=_DTYPE,
+    )
+    decls = kv_layer_decls(
+        full_layer_ids=(0,),
+        full_geometry=geometry,
+        windows=[
+            WindowLayers(layer_ids=(i + 1,), geometry=geometry, window=w)
+            for i, w in enumerate(windows)
+        ],
+    )
+    plan = plan_kv_storage(decls, page_size=1)
+    sized = size_plan(
+        plan,
+        KVSizingInputs(
+            full_tokens=512,
+            window_tokens=512,
+            state_slots=0,
+            max_running_requests=4,
+            context_len=_CONTEXT,
+            alignment=1,
+        ),
+    )
+    ctx = UnifiedBuildContext(
+        device="cuda",
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=len(windows) + 1,
+        enable_memory_saver=False,
+        need_sort=False,
+        max_num_reqs=4,
+        model_context_len=_CONTEXT,
+        lazy_compaction=False,
+    )
+    return build_kv_storage(plan, sized, ctx)
+
+
+class _Model:
+    """A unified pool over one full layer and one layer per window, a Triton
+    backend bound to its runner, and the K/V every layer has written so far."""
+
+    def __init__(self, windows, *, spec_algorithm=SpeculativeAlgorithm.NONE):
+        setup_allocator_context()
+        storage = _storage(windows)
+        case = DenseAttentionCase(
+            name="several_windows",
+            backend="triton",
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            num_heads=_HEADS,
+            num_kv_heads=_KV_HEADS,
+            page_size=1,
+            prefix_lens=(0,) * 4,
+            sliding_window_size=max(windows),
+        )
+        runner = MockModelRunner(
+            case=case,
+            model_config=TinyModelConfig(
+                num_heads=_HEADS,
+                num_kv_heads=_KV_HEADS,
+                head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+                hidden_size=_HEADS * _HEAD_DIM,
+                context_len=_CONTEXT,
+                sliding_window_size=max(windows),
+            ),
+            dtype=_DTYPE,
+            device="cuda",
+            max_context_len=_CONTEXT,
+            head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+            runner_batch_size=4,
+        )

+        runner.req_to_token_pool = storage.requests
+        runner.token_to_kv_pool = self.allocator.get_kvcache()
+        runner.token_to_kv_pool_allocator = self.allocator
+        runner.sliding_window_size = max(windows)
+        runner.spec_algorithm = spec_algorithm
+        runner.init_runner_ids()
+        self.runner = runner
+        self.backend = TritonAttnBackend(runner)
+        self.layers = [
+            RadixAttention(
+                num_heads=_HEADS,
+                head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+                scaling=_HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+                num_kv_heads=_KV_HEADS,
+                layer_id=layer_id,
+                sliding_window_size=window,
+            )
+            for layer_id, window in enumerate((-1, *windows))
+        ]
+        # Per request row: its virtual token ids, then per layer its K and V.
+        self.ids = {}
+        self.kv = {}
+
+    def bind(self):
+        self.runner.runner_ids.bind_and_verify_backends([self.backend])
+
+    def add_request(self, row, length, generator):
+        self.ids[row] = self.allocator.alloc(length)
+        self.runner.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token[row, :length] = self.ids[row].to(
+            torch.int32
+        )
+        self.kv[row] = [
+            (
+                torch.randn(
+                    (length, _KV_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM),
+                    generator=generator,
+                    device="cuda",
+                    dtype=_DTYPE,
+                ),
+                torch.randn(
+                    (length, _KV_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM),
+                    generator=generator,
+                    device="cuda",
+                    dtype=_DTYPE,
+                ),
+            )
+            for _ in self.layers
+        ]
+
+    def batch(self, mode, rows, prefix_lens, input_lens):
+        seq_lens = [p + n for p, n in zip(prefix_lens, input_lens)]
+        positions = [p + i for p, n in zip(prefix_lens, input_lens) for i in range(n)]
+        out = torch.cat(
+            [self.ids[r][p : p + n] for r, p, n in zip(rows, prefix_lens, input_lens)]
+        )
+        batch = ForwardBatch(
+            forward_mode=mode,
+            batch_size=len(rows),
+            input_ids=torch.zeros(len(positions), dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+            out_cache_loc=out,
+            seq_lens_sum=sum(seq_lens),
+            positions=torch.tensor(positions, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        )
+        self.runner.runner_ids.bind_own_plan(batch)
+        if mode.is_extend():
+            batch.extend_prefix_lens = torch.tensor(
+                prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+            )
+            batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu = list(prefix_lens)
+            batch.extend_seq_lens = torch.tensor(
+                input_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+            )
+            batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu = list(input_lens)
+            batch.extend_num_tokens = sum(input_lens)
+        return batch
+
+    def inputs(self, rows, prefix_lens, input_lens, generator):
+        """Per layer: q, and the k and v the batch writes."""
+        n = sum(input_lens)
+        result = []
+        for layer_id in range(len(self.layers)):
+            q = torch.randn(
+                (n, _HEADS * _HEAD_DIM),
+                generator=generator,
+                device="cuda",
+                dtype=_DTYPE,
+            )
+            k = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    self.kv[r][layer_id][0][p : p + m]
+                    for r, p, m in zip(rows, prefix_lens, input_lens)
+                ]
+            )
+            v = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    self.kv[r][layer_id][1][p : p + m]
+                    for r, p, m in zip(rows, prefix_lens, input_lens)
+                ]
+            )
+            result.append((q, k, v))
+        return result
+
+    def forward(self, batch, inputs):
+        outputs = []
+        for layer, (q, k, v) in zip(self.layers, inputs):
+            fn = (
+                self.backend.forward_decode
+                if batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                else self.backend.forward_extend
+            )
+            outputs.append(fn(q, k, v, layer, batch))
+        return outputs
+
+    def reference(self, mode, rows, prefix_lens, input_lens, inputs):
+        """Attention from positions: a window layer's query at position p reads
+        keys from p - window (extend) or p + 1 - window (decode) through p."""
+        outputs = []
+        for layer, (q, _, _) in zip(self.layers, inputs):
+            window = layer.sliding_window_size
+            out, start = [], 0
+            for r, p, m in zip(rows, prefix_lens, input_lens):
+                keys, values = self.kv[r][layer.layer_id]
+                for i in range(m):
+                    pos = p + i
+                    first = 0
+                    if window > -1:
+                        first = max(
+                            0, pos + 1 - window if mode.is_decode() else pos - window
+                        )
+                    query = q[start + i].view(_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM).float()
+                    group = _HEADS // _KV_HEADS
+                    k_ = keys[first : pos + 1].float().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+                    v_ = values[first : pos + 1].float().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+                    scores = torch.einsum("hd,khd->hk", query, k_) * layer.scaling
+                    probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
+                    out.append(torch.einsum("hk,khd->hd", probs, v_).reshape(-1))
+                start += m
+            outputs.append(torch.stack(out).to(_DTYPE))
+        return outputs
+
